newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine oil refinery, offshore co in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine oil refinery, offshore co in joint venture.

text.p: Ukraine's Anti-Monopoly Committee has allowed the Kherson oil refinery and an unknown Cayman Island-registered company called Producting and Trading to form a joint venture, a committee statement said on Wednesday.
"Permission is granted to create the closed joint-venture, called Kreking, to manufacture light oil products," it said.
No details were given about the foreign company or how much it was buying in AO Kherson Naftopererobka, which is capable of refinery 8.4 million tonnes of oil annually.
The refinery's deputy chief Volodymyr Emelyn said the refinery, a joint-stock company, was entirely state owned.
"There are two options on how to sell the refinery's shares through investment tender. But until the government approves a plan, I cannot say how large the share packages would be," he said.
He said that government intended to retain a portion of shares in the refinery, which last year refined 2.16 million tonnes, reflecting sharp declines in Russian oil supplies.
Last month managers of Russia's LUKoil told Reuters that they were considering purchasing shares in three of Ukraine's six refineries, including Kherson.
